question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Classified** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Classified **means arranged or organized into categories or groups. (श्रेणियों या समूहों में व्यवस्थित या संगठित) • **Example**: *The documents were classified based on their importance.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 4. Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Magnified **means made bigger or more prominent. (बड़ा या अधिक प्रमुख बनाया गया) • **Restricted **means limited or confined. (सीमित) • **Indulged **means allowing oneself to enjoy something. (स्वयं को किसी चीज़ का आनंद लेने की अनुमति देना) 4b:T908, The correct answer is: **Clues**
